articles.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills two, minister says | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 胡塞武装对也门总统府的导弹袭击造成两人死亡，部长表示| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
The Houthis in Yemen have attacked the presidential palace in the port city of Aden - the seat of the internationally-recognised government. 
 
Meanwhile, President Masoud Pezeshkian has told Iranians that the country is facing its most intense blockade since the 1979 Islamic Revolution, and has accused the US of seeking to provoke public protests.
 
The Saudi-led military coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis says it has intercepted a missile in the Medina region. The Houthis have threatened more attacks on Saudi Arabia but have denied carrying out this one.
 
Finally, according to reports, the US is considering using its biggest non-nuclear bomb against Iran if President Donald Trump should decide to renew combat in the war that has hit a deadlock.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

也门的胡塞武装袭击了港口城市亚丁的总统府--国际公认的政府所在地。

与此同时，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安（ Masoud Pezeshkian ）告诉伊朗人，该国正面临自1979年伊斯兰革命以来最严厉的封锁，并指责美国试图挑起公众抗议。

沙特领导的打击也门胡塞武装的军事联盟表示，它已经在麦地那地区拦截了一枚导弹。

胡塞武装威胁要对沙特阿拉伯发动更多袭击，但否认进行了这次袭击。

最后，据报道，如果唐纳德·特朗普总统决定在陷入僵局的战争中重启战斗，美国正在考虑对伊朗使用其最大的非核炸弹。

articles.title: The IDF says it’s investigating hundreds of deadly incidents. What happened to them? | BBC Verify
articles.titleZh: 以色列国防军表示，它正在调查数百起致命事件。他们怎么了？ | BBC Verify
articles.summary:
The BBC has identified 254 incidents in which the Israeli military has been accused of killing or injuring people that it said it was investigating but have had no public outcome. 
 
BBC Verify analysed incidents in Gaza, Lebanon, the occupied West Bank and Israel in which the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) faced allegations of harm since the start of the Gaza war, which was triggered by the Hamas-led attacks on 7 October 2023. 
 
We approached the IDF multiple times but only received information on two incidents. It said that it took “every allegation or report raising concerns about conduct" seriously.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: Did US President Donald Trump 'betray' Ukraine? | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普是否“背叛”乌克兰？ | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
President Zelensky admitted he felt ‘betrayed’ by Trump in an interview with Piers Morgan. Where does that leave the US-Ukraine relationship?

Adam is joined by Sarah Smith, Americast host, and Shashank Joshi, Washington bureau chief at The Economist, to discuss what we’ve learned from Zelensky’s interview. Plus, what is going on with intelligence sharing between the US and Ukraine? And why is Starlink so important to the Ukrainian battlefield?

And, Keith Brown, Depute Leader of the SNP, is in Aberdeen to discuss the party conference and the SNP’s focus on securing another independence referendum, plus whether Andy Burnham travelling to Scotland during conference is a distraction.

articles.title: She was all in on MAGA. Then came the Epstein Files.
articles.titleZh: 她全神贯注于MAGA。然后是爱泼斯坦档案。
articles.summary:
She went to 42 Trump rallies, sold everything to follow his campaign, and devoted years of her life to MAGA. Then, Trump's handling of the Epstein files changed everything. Former Trump supporter Trisha Hope tells @doniecnn about the moment she walked away... and her emotional encounter with an Epstein survivor. To hear more, check out The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper Saturday, October 17 at 8pm on CNN and available to subscribers on the CNN App.    

00:00  Inside the Trump-Epstein exhibit 
01:25  A life devoted to MAGA 
02:14  The moment everything changed
03:15 Questioning Trump, but not the 2020 election 
04:49  An emotional meeting with an Epstein survivor 
06:17 Leaving MAGA behind

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

articles.readingText:

articles.title: Eight states sue OpenAI over child safety concerns
articles.titleZh: 八个州因儿童安全问题起诉OpenAI
articles.summary: Eight states filed separate consumer protection lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging that the company deceived parents and hurt children with its chatbot ChatGPT. The states that filed lawsuits include Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana.

articles.readingText:
Eight states filed separate consumer protection lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging that the company deceived parents and hurt children with its chatbot ChatGPT.

The states that filed lawsuits include Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana.
articles.readingTextZh:
八个州分别对OpenAI提起消费者保护诉讼，指控该公司通过其聊天机器人ChatGPT欺骗父母并伤害儿童。

提起诉讼的州包括爱荷华州、堪萨斯州、内布拉斯加州、西弗吉尼亚州、阿肯色州、亚利桑那州、爱达荷州和蒙大拿州。
